name: security-review
description: Security review of the current git diff for Bunkar OS. Read-only.
prompt: Perform a security review of the current changes (`git diff` staged+unstaged and vs the main branch). Focus on: authentication and role enforcement (owner / munshi / thekedar); unauthenticated slip links and exporter token links (must be unguessable, expiring, and scoped to a single resource); PII of weavers (photos, phone numbers, UPI IDs) — exposure, logging, or over-broad access; injection and XSS; hardcoded secrets or credentials; and least-privilege permissions (the PWA must not request SMS or contacts access). Report only findings that are exploitable or clearly risky, each with concrete file:line evidence and the attack scenario. Do not modify files.
